en.headline: Police arrest 20 after raiding three suspected vice venues in Yau Ma Tei
en.dek: Officers detained four local men, one local woman and 15 foreign women aged 20 to 57; some face charges of managing or permitting prostitution premises.
body: Police raided three suspected prostitution premises in Yau Ma Tei on Thursday and arrested 20 people, police said.

Those arrested comprised four local men, one local woman and 15 foreign women, aged between 20 and 57. Two local men and the local woman were arrested on suspicion of managing a prostitution establishment. The 15 foreign women, aged 20 to 42, were arrested on suspicion of breaching conditions of stay. Two other local men were arrested on suspicion of permitting premises to be used as a prostitution establishment; they were released on bail and must report to police in early December.

The remaining arrested persons have been charged with relevant offences and are due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on Friday morning. Police seized a quantity of items related to illegal prostitution, including condoms and towels, during the operation.
The arrests follow intelligence-led action targeting suspected vice activities in the district.

zh.headline: 警油麻地搞破三個懷疑賣淫場所 拘捕20人
zh.dek: 行動拘捕4名本地男子、1名本地女子及15名外籍女子，部分人涉嫌經營或准許處所用作賣淫場所。
body: 警方今日在油麻地搞破三個懷疑賣淫場所，拘捕20人。
被捕人士包括4名本地男子、1名本地女子及15名外籍女子，年齡介乎20至57歲。兩名本地男子及一名本地女子涉嫌「經營賣淫場所」被捕；15名外籍女子（年齡20至42歲）涉嫌「違反逗留條件」被捕。另外兩名本地男子涉嫌「准許處所經營作賣淫處所」，已獲准保釋，須於12月上旬向警方報到。
其餘被捕人已被暫控相關罪行，案件將於明日上午在九龍城裁判法院提堂。行動中警方檢獲大量與非法賣淫相關的證物，包括安全套及毛巾等。
警方指行動根據情報進行，針對區內懷疑賣淫活動。
